item.title: Weight loss drug prescribing to be incentivised in new GP contract
item.description: New obesity targets will be added to the QOF from April that will incentivise practices to prescribe weight loss drugs where clinically appropriate, the government has announced.

item.title: First vitiligo treatment approved for NHS use
item.description: NICE has recommended the vitiligo treatment ruxolitinib after initially rejecting the drug in draft guidance.

item.title: MIMS Learning Live Digital: a week of free learning supporting your clinical practice
item.description: Register for free learning every evening from 9-12 March to gain CPD hours and support your patients.

item.title: Prescriptions for ‘transformative’ oral migraine drugs triple since NICE approval
item.description: GP prescriptions for the oral migraine drugs atogepant and rimegepant have more than tripled after NICE approved the therapies.

item.title: Prescribing-related QOF changes announced as part of new GP contract
item.description: The new GP contract for 2026/27 will include changes to GP practice incentives relating to prescribing of medications for conditions including obesity, heart failure and stroke.

item.title: Use shared decision-making to review gabapentinoids and other long-term medications, says GP
item.description: Clinicians should approach reviews of gabapentinoids and other long-term medications in collaboration with the patient to ensure they are not continuing medications for pain that has long since resolved, says GP Dr Sam Finnikin in an episode of the MIMS Learning podcast.

item.title: 'Simple strategy' of starting heart failure drugs earlier could have large public health benefits, study suggests
item.description: Early initiation of SGLT2 inhibitors in people with suspected heart failure who have a pre-existing indication for the drugs, such as type II diabetes, may improve outcomes, according to a cohort study.

item.title: Sign up now for essential clinical updates and prescribing information at MIMS Learning Live Digital
item.description: MIMS Learning Live Digital starts on Monday 9 March: don’t miss practical learning that will count towards your appraisal, and improve your prescribing practice.

item.title: GLP-1 research highlights: including potential asthma and addiction benefits, reduced dose frequency, and greater weight loss in women
item.description: GLP-1 agonists may offer secondary benefits in asthma and substance use disorders, but could increase the risk of conditions such as gout, emerging research suggests. This round-up of GLP-1 studies also summarises other recent insights for the drugs.

item.title: Review anticoagulant dosing but do not stop prescribing in frail patients, says cardiology GP
item.description: Clinicians should review anticoagulant dosing rather than stopping the drugs in frail older people with atrial fibrillation, GP Dr Chris Arden has said in a podcast.
